{18:2F}... ahh, what will become of {18:2F}?

being gathered in {18:2F}...

We lost the battle for {18:2F} because of the difference in equipment.
The Empire's soldiers were using weapons
and armor made of {18:04}.

The Empire has found {18:04} somewhere.
I ordered a man named Josef, who lives in Salamand,
to investigate, but there has been no word yet.
Would you go to Salamand together with Minwu?

きっと　あなたがたの　たすけになります。
ミンウとともに　サラマンドへ　いってください。

Minwu is a white wizard of great virtue.
He will surely be a help to you.
Please go to Salamand together with Minwu.

The Empire, too, suffered great losses in the battle
for {18:2F}. To make up for them, it is building
the [{16:01}{18:F3}] in Bafsk.

The {18:F3} is an enlarged [{16:09}{18:F5}]
loaded with a great many weapons.
The Empire is making the people of Bafsk
build the {18:F3}.

A man named Cid, who led the White Knights
of {18:2F}, built an airship, but
its allure stole his body and soul,
and he left {18:2F}.
Now he lives in the town of Poft, taking money
from travelers to give them rides in his airship.
They say he pours every bit of that money into
improving the airship's performance.

ja:

So that is the {18:04}?!
Please take it to Tobul at the town's weapon shop,
{18:EC} beg you. Ahh, now we can fight the Empire
on equal terms!!

The {18:EE} who oversees the building of the [{16:01}{18:F3}]
seems to be a capable man. Fortunately, he has
suddenly been called back to Palamecia.
No doubt they're in a panic at having the {18:04} taken from them.

Our comrades in Bafsk say they have found
a secret passage that leads to the battleship.

its completion will do.
With your strength and {13:02}'s, I believe
there is nothing you cannot do.

{10:02}, destroy the great battleship
without a moment's delay."

Thanks to Minwu, Father seems to be
much more comfortable.

{18:EF}: "The great battleship's attack killed
many people. How are we to fight
something like that? I wonder if anyone
knows its weak point..."

and {18:EB}.

have to run such a risk!

{18:EF}: "The {18:08} is the symbol of
Kashuon, and it still burns on
the first floor of the castle. I have heard several
stories about the flame from Scott and {18:EB}.

transferred to an ordinary torch..."

be able to destroy the great battleship."
{18:EF}: "Is that true!!
Please go at once.
Cid will surely take you to Kashuon.
But how will you bring the flame back, I wonder?"

{18:EF}: "My, {13:02}! It's been a long time.

captured by the Empire.
Please help {10:02} once again."

てにいれてください!

Please obtain the {18:04}
without a moment's delay!

en:
In exchange for that bell, Josef...........
With it, you can enter Castle Kashuon.
Every moment counts.
For your return, we'll come to pick you up in Cid's airship.

{18:EF}: "{18:EB}! You are such a...
If you had been here, Josef would not have had to die!"

{18:EF}: "I don't want to hear anything you have to say!"

{18:EF}: "{10:02}! {11:02}! {12:02}!
Thank you for rescuing me.
I hear you destroyed the great battleship as well.
Ahh, I have no words to thank you enough."

My, {13:02}! And here I thought you'd vanished!!
As {18:EB} has planned, {18:EC} and the others will draw
the enemy's attention, and meanwhile
you will slip into Castle {18:2F}
and strike down the enemy commander.

and you will come to the great hall.
The enemy should be there. Be careful.

[{16:01}{18:F8}]へ　いってくれませんか?

{18:EF}: "At last we have been able to come back here.
This, too, is the result of everyone joining forces.
I thank you all.

One thing that weighs on me is Minwu, who headed
for {18:F8}. There has been no word from him since.
Would you go to [{16:01}{18:F8}]?"

{18:F8} is the land of mages.
Without borrowing the power of their magic,
it will be hard to defeat the Emperor.

I hear a powerful magic is sealed
in the tower of {18:F8}.
It seems that for that, the [{16:08}{18:FE}]
is needed.

They say that long, long ago a passage to hell opened,
and many monsters swarmed onto the surface.
At that time, by the power of that magic,
the monsters were driven back.

Those brave Dragon Knights are gone now, then.
But {18:EC} still have you.

From this castle's Hall of Mirrors you can

    ...[{16:07}{18:FF}]...

I'm sorry. {18:EC} don't know where
that door is.

en:
{18:EF}: "Take that {18:0B} and go
to the town of Mysidia.
The mages will surely know
more about it."

en:
{18:EF}: "With that {18:0D}
you can enter the tower, can't you."

{18:EF}: "To think you were swallowed
by the legendary Leviathan...

{18:EF}: "You are... a Dragon Knight?!"
{13:02}: "It is an honor to meet you.

{18:EC} went to Mysidia to fetch
the {18:BF}.

{18:2F}じょうの　かがみのまから　{18:0E}を

Why not try calling a {18:0E} from the
Hall of Mirrors in Castle {18:2F}?
But it's probably still an egg.

{18:EF}「{18:F0}は　まりょくで　[{16:11}{18:FC}]を

{18:EF}: "With his magic, the {18:F0} has created
a [{16:11}{18:FC}], destroyed Altea, Gatea,

to this {18:2F}!"

The {18:F0} himself must surely be controlling

{18:EF}: "My, isn't that a {18:0E}!!

{18:0E}にのってそらから　たつまきに　はいれるかも

Riding a {18:0E}, you might be able to enter
the tornado from the sky.

{18:0E}のつばさが　たつまきのちからに　たえられれば

en:
If only the {18:0E}'s wings can withstand
the power of the tornado...

{11:02}「せっとくしてみます。　きっと{18:F0}の

{18:EF}: "So the {18:EE} was {07}...

{18:EF}: "The {18:EE} has succeeded the {18:F0}

en:
Castle Palamecia is surrounded by mountains
and cannot be approached on foot.

{18:EF}: "They say that when the monsters of hell
once overran the world, they came
through a passage called [{16:04}{18:FD}]."

en: There is a place by that name over toward Mysidia.

Minwu: "{18:EC} can see your fate.
